purpose: Paired seed difference-in-differences of SB-SN gaps between prespecified factorial groups; all cells/domain/task/macro and both AUC/logloss. Reuses existing exact point/seed summaries; no new bootstrap arithmetic or training.
inputs: Completed v3_marginal_statistics output made with --joint-window, its completed aggregate/manifest, explicit baseline group and full group list; all groups same seed set, primary seeds2022..2025 unless explicit extension.
estimands: For each seed/split/readout/variable: (SB-SN)_condition-(SB-SN)_baseline; also report SN_condition-SN_base and SB_condition-SB_base. common_pre_AULC requires identical global horizon across all factorial groups; common epochs require identical epochs. Independently selected epochs retained but explicitly condition-dependent, never an equal-time causal contrast. All actual epoch/horizon and source budgets retained.
statistics: Frozen r.paired_summary: deterministic 20000 paired seed bootstrap draws and exhaustive sign enumeration; no new mechanistic gate.
checks: Completed sources and joint_window true, unique records, identical keys/seeds, common horizons exact; validate analytic contrasts against one direct raw-cell case and baseline self-contrast zero. Minimal arithmetic verification only.
